issues: The title and characters identify the appointed Pahoran in scene_002 as “Pahoran”; the supplied verses do not explicitly identify him as Pahoran's son. The notes correctly caution against asserting that relationship.
The narration calls Pacumeni's action “his subsequent response,” but verse 6 does not establish how much time passed after the appointment.
The explicit fact that Tubaloth supposes Coriantumr can prevail through strength and wisdom is supported by Helaman 1:16, but the narration excerpts omit it; the summary does include the supposition.
The character label Lehi (Nephite commander) relies on the established label and the verse's statement that Moronihah sent Lehi with an army; the verses do not explicitly call him a commander.
